final_answer.key_evidence_summary: In namespace boutique only adservice is degraded: pod adservice-7b5ff9bbd7-r2s5r is 0/1 in Status ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff with events 'Failed to pull image "ghost-registry.example.net/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservice:v0.10.3" ... dial tcp: lookup ghost-registry.example.net on 127.0.0.53:53: no such host' and ContainersReady=False, so the container never starts. GetAppYAML(adservice) shows the pod template image was pointed at a non-existent registry host ghost-registry.example.net, while all other 10 boutique Deployments run 1/1 AVAILABLE pulling from us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/*:v0.10.3 — proving cluster registry DNS/credentials/pull path are otherwise healthy, i.e. the fault is a bad image reference unique to adservice. GetResources(endpoints, name=adservice) returns an empty endpoint set (Service selector app=adservice matches pod labels), so callers such as frontend (AD_SERVICE_ADDR=adservice:9555) cannot resolve any backend — the reported service availability disruption. No metric alerts (GetAlerts) support a performance-class fault.
